offline_contract: self-contained applet HTML with no required account, backend, package manager, or runtime network dependency

historical_manifest_note: Versioned tools/applets_*.json remain legacy inputs during R1, but the final public applet catalogue is now owned by src/product/catalogue.json and must be byte-equivalent to the legacy output before handoff.
